items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: But Mr. Martin worked in the factory of Stauffer in Vienna.

ctx.x: Well you were, before we turned the camera on, you were saying you perform tomorrow night, and then the “real” gigs start. And I wondered what that means.

Oh only in terms of just the money gigs. I mean I’m here at this conference on my own recognizance. It’s not like they hired me to come and perform. And I did a short artist-in- residence thing at Northeast Washington University. And Sheila, who is the current chairwoman said, “oh you should come to the conference, we’ll get you a performance spot.” And so I went through — my presentation that I’m doing, I had to put in an application like everybody else does. But it fit right into my own agenda. I got approached…
Well it’s a good thing that you’re pursuing that.
